items.title: From ‘Billionaire Bunker’ to Beverly Hills: The properties that make up Jeff Bezos’ $500 million real estate empire
items.description: As Amazon soars, nowhere is Bezos’ astronomical wealth more tangibly displayed than in his $500 million real estate empire.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway finally started spending its nearly $400 billion in cash — on one stock it knows very well
items.description: Berkshire is buying its own stock after years of building up a cash pile. Not everyone is excited.

items.title: U.S. stock futures flat as investors await inflation data, grapple with more Iran uncertainty
